**💡 Today's learning: "Multigrain bread is whole-grain bread"**
- 🤔 **What people believe:** A loaf that says multigrain, seven-grain or cracked wheat must be the healthy whole-grain kind.
- 🔬 **The fact:** A Mayo Clinic dietitian says words like multigrain, seven-grain or cracked wheat don't guarantee a whole grain (Mayo Clinic, Sep 2017). Look for a label that actually says whole grain.
- 🎯 **How they fool you:** The grain count goes on the front because it sounds wholesome, even when the flour is refined. Read the ingredient list instead.
- **Source:** https://newsnetwork.mayoclinic.org/discussion/mayo-clinic-minute-why-whole-grains-are-the-healthier-choice/
